one_line: New AI models launch, robotics benchmarks advance, consumer assistants expand, and NVIDIA tools spread across Europe.

themes.title: Robotics benchmarks highlight frontier models
themes.text: Researchers evaluated six frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 robot manipulation suite, with GPT‑6 Astra achieving 44% success, while new frameworks PAPAV and Environment Duels analyze multimodal agent functions and co‑evolution of LLMs in dynamic environments.

stories.headline: Frontier AI models evaluated on LIBERO-10 robot tasks, GPT‑6 Astra tops at 44% success
Paper proposes PAPAV framework to unify multimodal agents and robots
Environment Duels benchmark studies LLM co‑evolution through author‑solver interactions

themes.title: Multimodal models and voice agents released
themes.text: Mistral AI previewed its 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model Mistral Large 4 and released the Voxtral 3 voice‑agent SDK supporting over 50 languages. Anthropic introduced the Claude Duet proactive AI agent for professionals, and OpenAI announced that its GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models will be available on Google Cloud for select enterprise customers.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud

themes.title: AI assistants enter consumer products
themes.text: Google enabled its Gemini AI assistant for conversational navigation on Apple CarPlay in the United States; Walmart will let third‑party AI agents shop for customers through an Agent Gateway using Model Context Protocol; and Mistral partnered with Mozilla to power the Firefox Smart Window beta browsing assistant in France and North America.

stories.headline: Google adds conversational Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay in US
Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
Mistral and Mozilla launch AI‑powered Firefox Smart Window beta

themes.title: NVIDIA open models adopted in Europe
themes.text: NVIDIA’s open‑weight AI models are being integrated into European government projects, weather and climate forecasting, retail inference pipelines, AI infrastructure power management, and the Cosmos platform, with implementations reported by the European Commission, Poland, AXA, Shopify, and Porsche.

stories.headline: NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models
NVIDIA DSX platform used to address power bottleneck in AI infrastructure
NVIDIA expands Cosmos platform with new training tools and data factory blueprints
